semantics.Y1: Assert when current state is A and w=1; y[0] & w
semantics.Y3: Assert when current state is B, C, E, or F and w=0; (y[1] | y[2] | y[4] | y[5]) & ~w
semantics.timing: Outputs continuously follow current inputs; no clock or cycle latency, registers, reset, or initialization. External state flip-flops are not implemented.
semantics.legal_inputs: One-hot y encodes one of the six states, w is binary.
semantics.invalid_inputs: Zero-hot, multi-hot, and unknown-valued inputs are not specified by the original problem; no recovery logic is required.

numeric.representation: Unsigned six-bit state vector and one-bit Boolean input and outputs
numeric.operations: One-bit bitwise AND, OR, NOT only
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, truncation, saturation, or overflow applies.

verification.oracle: Independent explicit transition table for all six states and both binary values of w. Compare whether destination is B (Y1) or D (Y3).
verification.coverage: All 12 legal state/input pairs in repeated forward and reverse traversal to exercise input changes.
verification.tool: Icarus v12 and matching vvp with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top
verification.timeout: Each compile and simulation command limited to 20 seconds; testbench also has finite simulation watchdog.
verification.review: Check exact module/ports, complete combinational driving, no sequential elements and no extra behavior.

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for non-one-hot or X/Z-valued state/input signals is unspecified; verification covers the stated one-hot binary domain.
